kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-route-distribution-strategies --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-erx3qta5xg5zyq0000 --source-type cloud --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRouteDistributionStrategies

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of route. Valid values:

cloud: Alibaba Cloud-facing routes. These routes allow SAG instances to access resources deployed on Alibaba Cloud.
local: on-premises network-facing routes. These routes allow SAG instances to communicate with on-premises terminals
parameters.help_zh:
路由类型：

cloud：云上路由。智能接入网关到云上资源的路由。

local：线下路由。智能接入网关到线下节点的路由
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前分页的页码数。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页展示时，每个分页包含的列表条目数。默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页展示时，每个分页包含的列表条目数

Strategy.description_en: A list of route advertisement policies

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the health check instance was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 健康检查实例的创建时间戳，单位为毫秒

HcInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the health check instance

IsConflict.description_en:
Indicates whether routes are overlapped. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
IsConflict.description_zh:
是否存在路由冲突：

true：是。

false：否

RouteDistribution.description_en:
The route advertisement policy. Valid values:

publish: advertises routes.
no_publish: does not advertise routes.
no_publish_and_publish_on_health_success: routes are advertised only when they pass the health check.
no_publish_and_publish_on_health_fail: routes are advertised only when they fail the health check.
publish_and_revoke_on_health_success: advertised routes are withdrawn only when they pass the health check.
publish_and_revoke_on_health_fail: advertised routes are withdrawn only when they fail the health check.

For more information, see [Configure health checks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163971.html） and [Advertise routes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163973.html）
RouteDistribution.description_zh:
路由发布策略：

publish：发布。
no_publish：不发布。
no_publish_and_publish_on_health_success：不发布-健康检查成功时发布。
no_publish_and_publish_on_health_fail：不发布-健康检查失败时发布。
publish_and_revoke_on_health_success：发布-健康检查成功时撤销。
publish_and_revoke_on_health_fail：发布-健康检查失败时撤销。

更多详情请参见[关联健康检查]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163971.html）和[路由发布]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163973.html）

RouteSource.description_en:
The source of routes. Valid values:

Alibaba Cloud-facing routes

    *   Virtual private clouds (VPCs) IDs: Routes that are learned from the VPCs.
    *   Virtual border routers (VBRs): Routes that are learned from VBRs.
    *   SAG instance IDs: Routes that are learned from SAG instances.

On-premises network-facing routes

    *   STATIC: Static routes that are specified in the SAG console.
    *   OSPF: Routes that are learned through the Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) protocol.
    *   BGP: Routes that are learned through Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
RouteSource.description_zh:
路由来源：

云上路由
    - 专有网络（VPC）实例ID：通过VPC学来的路由。
    - 虚拟边界路由器（VBR）实例ID：通过VBR学来的路由。
    - 智能接入网关（SAG）实例ID：通过SAG学来的路由。

线下路由
    - STATIC：通过管理控制台添加的静态路由。
    - OSPF：通过OSPF路由协议学习来的路由。
    - BGP：通过BGP路由协议学习来的路由

SmartAGId.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the route. Valid values:

cloud: Alibaba Cloud-facing routes.
local: on-premises network-facing routes
SourceType.description_zh:
路由类型：

cloud：云上路由。

local：线下路由

Status.description_en:
The route status. Valid values:

normal: The route is working as expected.
revoked: The route has been withdrawn
Status.description_zh:

revoked：已撤销

The route advertisement status. Valid values:

not_publish: The route has not been advertised
StrategyPublishStatus.description_zh:

not_publish：未发布
